title: View tabs
description: A row of view-switcher tabs styled like the bottom panel's (Problems / Output / Debug Console / Terminal) and the Settings editor scope tabs in the modern UI: borderless text tabs where the active one sits on a rounded pill. Renders the panel's composite bar (`.pane-composite-part > .composite.title > .composite-bar-container > .composite-bar > .monaco-action-bar > ul[role=tablist]`) so the captured panel rules apply unchanged, without the panel part around it. Known drift vs. the panel-title capture: the panel's title row adds 2px/4px padding and a flex layout from `.part.panel > .title` (panel-specific, intentionally not reproduced), and tab widths differ ~1px from platform font metrics (the capture was taken on Linux; computed font, padding and widths are identical to the verified <vsc-panel>).
usage: Use for switching between views or filtered lists inside a surface (panel views, settings scopes, inbox buckets). Children are <vsc-view-tab value>Label</vsc-view-tab>; set active to a value and listen for "change". Not for editor tabs (use <vsc-tabs>/<vsc-tab>).

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: value of the active <vsc-view-tab> (defaults to the first)

states.name: active
states.description: The tab whose value equals active gets the pill

examples.title: With counts
examples.html: <vsc-view-tabs active="ready" label="Inbox"><vsc-view-tab value="ready" count="6">Ready for you</vsc-view-tab><vsc-view-tab value="working" count="3">Working</vsc-view-tab><vsc-view-tab value="hold" count="2">On hold</vsc-view-tab><vsc-view-tab value="done">Done</vsc-view-tab></vsc-view-tabs>
